AMENDED TO BE A TYPE 1 22849-T
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
4203-11 West 5th Avenue / 732-44 South Keeler Avenue
From RT-4 to RM-4.5

The Property

The property is one vacant zoning lot located in an RT-4 zoning district within a Transit Served location
approximately 1,550 feet to the Pulaski Blue Line CTA Train Station entrance.

The property is comprised three parcels: Lot 1, 2, and 3.

Lot 1 is located on the southwest corner of West 5" Avenue and South Keeler Avenue and Lots 2 and 3 are
adjacent and located along 5" Avenue.

The Project
TECHCO SAVVY INC. (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property from a RT-4 Residential Singie-

Unit (Detached House) District to a RM-4,5, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to
subdivide the zoning lot into three individual zoning lots: Lot 1, Lot 2, and Lot 3.

The rezoning also will allow for the following improvements:

Lot 1: one three unit building with one rear surface parking space

Lot 2: one three unit building with a rear two car garage (50% as of right parking under 17-10-0102-B(c))
Lot 3: one three unit building with a rear two car garage (50% as of right parking under 17-10-0102-B(c))

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-
1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) and including:

An optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required east side setback pursuant to
section 17-2-0309 on Lot 1 to zero;

An optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required combined side setback pursuant
to section 17-2-0309 on Lot | to zero;

An optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required rear yard setback pursuant to
section 17-2-0306-C for Lot | to zero;

An optional variation under sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-EE to reduce 2 required parking
spaces to 1 space for Lot 1 for properties located in a Transit Served Location under sections 17-10-0207
and 17-10-0102-B(c).

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot 2: 2,880 square feet
Lot 3: 2,880 square feet

FAR: Lot 1: 1.32

Lot 2: 1.0
Lot 3: 1.0
